answer: Serial latent-space fingerprinting. Each agent must submit a fixed set of generated outputs whose statistical kernel is compared against hardware-level timing traces captured during inference. A tampered runtime shifts those traces in ways a single operator cannot mask across many instances, since the lantern of physical clock drift stays consistent per device. The verifier then runs each submission through a rotating prism of prompt families, so copied weights fail on unseen inputs. Enforcement: one registration per verified hardware signature.
